verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform with a console, CLI and API. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls, or any way to opt out. The cited items cover machines, notebooks, the API, the CLI and pricing, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
